# Fintech24h

> Fintech24h is a blockchain, crypto, Web3 and AI marketing agency legally based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. It runs KOL and influencer marketing, PR and media, community growth, event marketing, AI marketing and business development for blockchain projects in Vietnam, Singapore, Dubai and the UAE, the United States and Europe. It also runs Fi24h DealMakers' Club, a B2B matching community for Web3 and fintech decision-makers.

Key facts:
- Headquarters: 1014 Pham Van Dong Street, Hiep Binh, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. No branch offices; work outside Vietnam is delivered remotely and with on-the-ground partners.
- Contact: info@fintech24h.com, Telegram https://t.me/fintech24h
- Pricing: focused campaigns from about $3,000 to $5,000 per month depending on market; full-funnel engagements from about $15,000 per month.
- Campaigns avoid price predictions and promised returns; paid creator posts are disclosed; regulated claims are confirmed with the client's legal counsel.

## Services

- [Crypto KOL & Influencer Marketing](https://fintech24h.com/services/kol-marketing/): vetted crypto creators on X, YouTube, Telegram and TikTok, paid against delivery.
- [Crypto PR & Media](https://fintech24h.com/services/pr-media/): Tier-1 crypto and business press plus regional media.
- [Community Growth & Management](https://fintech24h.com/services/community-growth/): Telegram, Discord, X and Zalo communities moderated around the clock.
- [Event Marketing](https://fintech24h.com/services/event-marketing/): side events, AMAs and conference activations.
- [Crypto AI Marketing](https://fintech24h.com/services/ai-marketing/): human-supervised AI for community support, sentiment monitoring and content.
- [Business Development](https://fintech24h.com/services/business-development/): introductions to exchanges, VCs and ecosystem partners.
- [Custom Solutions](https://fintech24h.com/services/custom-solutions/): tailored AI, blockchain and growth engagements.
- [All services](https://fintech24h.com/services/)

## Markets

- [Blockchain marketing agency in Vietnam](https://fintech24h.com/blockchain-marketing-agency-vietnam/): home market; Vietnamese KOLs, Telegram and Zalo communities, local and Tier-1 media.
- [Blockchain marketing agency in Singapore](https://fintech24h.com/blockchain-marketing-agency-singapore/): institutional PR and MAS-aware positioning, with reach into Indonesia and Thailand.
- [Blockchain marketing agency in Dubai](https://fintech24h.com/blockchain-marketing-agency-dubai/): X-native KOLs, Gulf press and free-zone introductions; VARA-aware messaging.
- [Blockchain marketing agency for the USA](https://fintech24h.com/blockchain-marketing-agency-usa/): FTC-disclosed creator campaigns and credibility-led PR; SEC Section 17(b) awareness.
- [Blockchain marketing agency for Europe](https://fintech24h.com/blockchain-marketing-agency-europe/): MiCA-ready marketing for the EU, plus the UK's FCA financial promotions regime and Switzerland.

## Research

- [Insights blog](https://fintech24h.com/blog): research hub with search.
- [Knowledge](https://fintech24h.com/blog/category/knowledge): frameworks, rankings and deep dives on blockchain infrastructure, fintech and Web3 growth.
- [News](https://fintech24h.com/blog/category/news): market and industry news.
- [Partner Relationship](https://fintech24h.com/blog/category/partner-relationship): ecosystem partners and partner announcements.
- [Dealmakers Pulse](https://fintech24h.com/blog/category/dealmakers-pulse): media partners and KOLs joining Fi24h DealMakers' Club Season 3.
